author: Ross, Malcolm
title: Proto-Oceanic *kʷ
notes: Consulted directly on 23 November 2026 (Project MUSE PDF). Argues for a marginal POc *kʷ, word-initial before *a (one possible medial case, *sikʷa), kept as kʷ in some Papuan Tip languages and Fijian dialects, merged with *k elsewhere, but reflected as Proto-Southeast Solomonic *k where POc *k gives PSES *ɣ (pp. 25-31, 40); doublets in *ka-/*ko- resolved as *kʷa- (§3); a tentative POc *gʷ (§5, pp. 39-40); usage-based discussion of marginal phonemes (§6).
